The `make` command did not find a makefile in the `texturing` directory, which is preventing it from building the program. To address this, I will create a simple `Makefile` in the `texturing` directory to build `tex1dfetch.cu`.

I will create a `Makefile` with the following content:

```makefile
CUDA_PATH ?= /usr/local/cuda
NVCC = $(CUDA_PATH)/bin/nvcc

CFLAGS = -I$(CUDA_PATH)/include -L$(CUDA_PATH)/lib64 -lcudart

all: tex1dfetch

tex1dfetch: tex1dfetch.cu
	$(NVCC) $(CFLAGS) -arch=sm_90 -o $@ $<

clean:
	rm -f tex1dfetch
```

This `Makefile` sets up the necessary flags and paths for building the CUDA program.

Now, I will write this `Makefile` to the repository and build the program again.
